title: Why Do LLMs Struggle in Strategic Play? Broken Links Between Observations, Beliefs, and Actions
abstract: arXiv:2605.00226v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly tasked with strategic decision-making under incomplete information, such as in negotiation and policymaking. While LLMs can excel at many such tasks, they also fail in ways that are poorly understood. We shed light on these failures by uncovering two fundamental gaps in the internal mechanisms underlying the decision-making of LLMs in incomplete-information games, supported by experiments with open-weight models Llama 3.1, Qwen3, and gpt-oss. First, an observation-belief gap: LLMs' internal representations of latent game states are substantially more accurate than their own verbal reports. However, these representations, which we call internal beliefs following game-theoretic terminology, are brittle. translated_title: 为什么大语言模型在策略博弈中举步维艰？观察、信念与行动之间的断裂链接
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被要求在不完全信息下进行战略决策，例如谈判和政策制定。虽然LLMs能够在许多此类任务中表现出色，但它们也会以人们知之甚少的方式失败。我们通过揭示LLMs在不完全信息博弈中决策背后的内部机制所存在的两个根本性差距来阐明这些失败，并以开源权重模型Llama 3.1、Qwen3和gpt-oss的实验作为支撑。第一，观察-信念差距：LLMs对潜在博弈状态的内部表征远比其自身的言语报告更为准确。然而，这些按照博弈论术语被称为“内部信念”的表征却是脆弱的：信念准确性会随着多跳推理而下降，表现出首因效应和近因效应偏差，并在长期交互中逐渐偏离贝叶斯一致性。第二，……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过Llama 3.1、Qwen3和gpt-oss的实验，揭示了LLMs在不完全信息博弈中失败的两个根本性内部机制差距：观察-信念差距（内部信念表征比言语报告更准确但脆弱、易受偏差影响并偏离贝叶斯一致性），以及信念与行动之间的断裂链接。
en_tdlr: This study reveals two fundamental internal-mechanism gaps behind LLMs' failures in incomplete-information games—an observation-belief gap, where internal belief representations are more accurate than verbal reports yet brittle, biased, and drifting from Bayesian coherence, and a broken link between beliefs and actions.
